messages.subject: Non-linear quantile regression in stat/geom_quantile?
parts:
I just wanted to see if anyone has used stat_quantile for non-linear quantile regressions (nlrq)?  The info page says it only supports rq and all the examples are for linear rq?  Any plans to make it work with nlrq or are those the bugs in quantreg that Hadley referred to in a previous post?   

Thanks,
Thomas
